verdict.rationale: Angular's CLI documents a first-party unit test command (`ng test` runs unit tests in a project). Its state is built on Signals and its logic is organized through dependency injection. A community user also cites easy testing via Karma and DI, though that comment is about AngularJS. None of the evidence explicitly shows testing signals, services or other state logic in isolation without rendering components or the DOM, so delivery of the specific DOM-free angle is only implied. Missing for 10: docs on testing signals/services without rendering, evidence of DOM-free test setups (e.g., TestBed or service-only tests), and independent hands-on corroboration for modern Angular.
